strings.\n**Где.** Панель графа → «Экспорт» (в р:
**Where.** The graph toolbar / Export (in Developer mode the button is in plain sight).

**Formats:** Yarn Spinner, Ink, Ren'Py, Twine (SugarCube), JSON for Unity and Godot,
C# ScriptableObject, GDScript, Unreal C++, localisation tables (CSV, JSON, Unreal String Table,
Unity Localization).

Conditions, variables and events become engine commands. For localisation fill in the string ids in the
node inspector — the tables then build themselves.

**Interface modes.** The switch in the status bar: Writer hides the technical fields, Developer shows
node ids, conditions as code and the export.
strings.\n**Документы** — обычный Markdown: табл:
**Documents** are plain Markdown: tables, checklists, and the text / side-by-side / preview modes.
A link like `[[Name]]` leads to another document, and creates it on click when there is none.
Tags are written as `#tag`.

**The canvas** is a board for notes, pictures and cards of project documents. It is created like any
file: File / New file / Canvas. A double-click on empty space makes a note; dragging a file from the
tree makes a document card. Cards connect with lines from any side.

**The character card** opens from a character node: five layouts, role presets, appearance and a PNG
export.

**Groups on the canvas.** The Group button or Group together for selected cards: a named frame that moves everything inside it.

**The whole project as one document.** File → Export project as a document (HTML, PDF)… — contents, documents, graphs in story order and canvases. Open the file in a browser; Print saves a PDF.

**Forget a project.** File → Forget project on this device… disconnects it from GitHub and removes its copy, history and chat data from the device. The repository does not change.
strings.\n**Закрытая папка** («Роли и доступ → З:
**A closed folder** (Roles and access / Close a folder) encrypts the contents before they are sent:
name a folder or a pattern (`Script/`, `*.secret.md`) and the roles that get the key. Without the key
the files never reach the app, and GitHub holds an unreadable envelope instead of the text.

**The keys** can be saved to a file (Save keys) — you need it for a second computer and for recovery.
The `decrypt-vault.mjs` script lives next to the files in the repository: the texts can be read without
{app}.

**What it does not do:** file names stay visible on GitHub, and whoever had the key may already have
downloaded the contents.

**The app password** (Settings / Security) locks {app} on a shared computer and encrypts the GitHub
token and your chat keys. The password cannot be recovered — forget it and you sign in again from
scratch.
strings.\n**Зачем.** GitHub заменяет собой серве:
**Why.** GitHub takes the place of a server: files, tasks, chat and documents live in your repository.
{app} has no server of its own, and there is nothing to pay for.

**How to connect.** Team / Connect the project to GitHub (or the GitHub icon in the top right corner).
Three steps follow:

1. **Sign in.** The “Sign in with GitHub” button asks you to type a short code on the site, and that is
   all. Without that button, sign in with a token: create one with the `repo` scope through the link in
   the window and paste it.
2. **What the repository is for.** Personal storage — only your files, synced between your own devices,
   without tasks and chat. Team project — everything, with people.
3. **The repository.** Pick an existing one or create a new one right there. An empty repository offers
   to push the project as the first commit.

**After that** the exchange runs by itself: every 45 seconds and whenever you return to the window. The
sync button is in the status bar at the bottom.

**The mode belongs to the project:** one project can be a team one while another stays entirely local.
strings.\n**Каналы** бывают открытые (видны всей:
**Channels** are either public (visible to the whole team) or private (invited members only, messages
encrypted). Direct messages are always end-to-end encrypted.

**A poll** is the button next to the paperclip: a question, up to ten options, one answer or several.
Your vote can be changed or withdrawn; the author and an administrator can close the poll.

**Tasks** are GitHub issues: a board, a list, sprints, assignees, labels, time tracking. A task can be
tied to a graph node and opened from it in one click.

**Team documents** — NDAs, contracts, rules: the administrator publishes, members sign in one click,
and the signature is recorded on GitHub.
strings.\n**Обратная связь** («Справка → Обратна:
**Feedback** (Help / Feedback) — pick the kind: a problem, a feature, a wish or a question. A problem
carries the log; the report is saved to a file or opened as an issue on GitHub. No project texts, no
messages and no tokens go into it.

**Backups** are made once a day: Settings / Backups lists them and restores a project as a separate copy.

**File version history** — Ctrl+H: checkpoints and a way back to any of them.

**A merge conflict.** When you and a teammate change the same place, {app} marks the file and does not
send it to the team until you pick the version you want.
strings.\n**Пригласить.** «Команда → Личный каби:
**Invite.** Team / Admin home / Invite to the team: a GitHub username and the Write permission. Do not
hand out anything higher (maintain, admin) — only those allow deleting the repository.

**Roles** (Roles and access) limit which folders a member can change in the app. Everything else opens
read-only and is never sent.

**Change review.** When it is on, a member's changes go to the administrator on a separate branch as a
pull request: the difference is visible file by file, and it can be accepted or rejected with a reason.

**About protection.** Roles work inside {app}. To stop a member writing to the main branch through the
GitHub site, turn on the “Require a pull request before merging” rule there — the app warns you when
the rule is off.

**Removing a member** closes GitHub access, drops the role, takes them out of the channels (private
ones get a new key) and rotates the keys of the closed folders. Files they downloaded earlier stay with
them — that is how any repository works.
strings.\n**Создайте проект.** «Файл → Новый про:
**Create a project.** File / New project, or a card on the start screen. Empty — when you build the
structure yourself; Narrative project — with ready folders for characters, locations and quests;
Dialogue scene — a small example with a condition and a variable.

**Where things live.** Project files are on the left. The strip of icons at the far left switches the
panels: files, variables, writer tools, tasks, chat, documents, change review, settings. The GitHub
account sits in the top right corner.

**A project is stored** either as a folder on disk (desktop) or inside the app. Autosave is on, and
every file keeps its own version history (Ctrl+H).

**Tip:** Ctrl+K opens the command palette — everything is there without remembering where the button is.
strings.\n**Создать узел:** кнопка «+ Узел» на п:
**Add a node:** the “+ Node” button on the toolbar, or a double-click on empty space. A right-click on
empty space opens the same menu (on a phone — a long press).

**Connect nodes:** drag from the dot on the edge of a node to another node. Release in empty space and
a menu appears — you can create a connected node right there.

**Node types:** start, line, character, location, quest, item, lore, idea, sound; the logic ones are a
condition (yes and no outputs), a variable change and an engine event. The type is changed in the
inspector or through the right-click menu.

**The inspector** opens with a double-click on a node (on a phone — a single tap): name, text,
condition, portrait, audio, localisation string id, custom attributes.

**Check the scene:** Play walks the dialogue as a player — conditions are evaluated, variables change.
Check finds dead ends, unreachable nodes, broken conditions and unknown variables.

**Templates.** Right-click an empty spot → Insert template: a dialogue with a choice, a condition check, a quest chain. Save your own selection with a right-click on a node → Save as template….

**Search the whole project** with Ctrl+Shift+F: nodes, texts, canvases, variables and tasks at once; clicking a node opens the graph and brings you to it.
strings.\n{app} на Android — то же приложение: п:
{app} on Android is the same app: projects, graphs, documents, chat and GitHub sync.

**Controls differ:** a long press replaces the right mouse button, a node opens with a single tap, menus
and panels take the whole screen, and the mini-map is hidden.

**Files** (reports, CSV, card PNGs) are saved through the system share sheet — pick Files, a drive or a
messenger.

**Projects as folders on disk** stay in the desktop version only: on a phone you get the in-app project
and GitHub sync.
